propositions: A new peer-confirmation record store must persist evidence of managed link creation with full details (link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, source) to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones in the inbound removal path.

The store is keyed on (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with relation scoping to match _inbound_unlink_one semantics, and persists as peer_confirmations.json under the bridge_state directory.

Write seam integrates via optional link_confirm callback in the dispatch path, invoked after successful set_relationship, capturing vendor link_id from the return value and translating Jira keys to local ids via binding_store.get_local_id.
Unbound targets (where get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely rather than persist vendor keys in local-id fields.
The store must be included in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to ensure confirmation-only changes survive the idempotency guard and are committed.

Load/save is fail-open: corrupt or absent store degrades to empty without aborting the pass, and callback exceptions are logged and swallowed to prevent confirmation writes from failing already-landed outbound links.
